notes.title: Firefighter Max Pressure Outfit for Jet
notes.content:
[i]When Jet caught her breath she was just outside of the burning hideout. Smoke was already filling the badly lit alleyway. Then it hit her; her trusty jetpack was still inside. Flames were spitting out of the doorway, it didn't look like she was able to go back in like this. She ran out to the street and saw the Shine City fire brigade setting up their gear. She pleaded to them to try and find the jetpack, to no avail. They sure weren't risking their lives for some 'toy'. Jet, not one to give up on a friend, smoothly zipped into one of their spare suits and jumped into the fire.[/i]

notes.title: Better Matchmaking incoming!
notes.content:
Season 6 has begun and we are bringing a few changes for it next week!

[h3][b]better matchmaking[/b][/h3]

A matchmaking timer will create more opportunity to find better matching opponents.

If you enter ranked mode and get a countdown, that means there is a player available that doesn't have the same division as you. The smaller the difference, the earlier you get matched up with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025459/bcf40fecf2e6f13153f9fb75cb905deed666f690.gif[/img]

[h3][b]rank down buffer limited to division 8[/b][/h3]

It was possible to exploit the buffer that requires you to lose two times before going down a division for progressing through the ranks. This also generated an excess amount of points on the board.

To combat both of these issues, the buffer is now limited to division 8. Season 6 may last longer than the previous ones as a result.

[h3][b]community tournaments[/b][/h3]

There are several community tournaments lined up on multiple platforms, here are the ones played on Steam:

The [url=https://challonge.com/SSTSRAexcla][b]Swingbait Special[/b][/url], a global tournament happening [i]in a few hours[/i].

The [url=https://challonge.com/CBvVL1][b]Blaze vs. LL1[/b][/url], a global tournament happening in a week - where the losers bracket is played in the first Lethal League game! It has a prize pool tied to the number of entrants and a player bounty.

And the [url=https://challonge.com/buntfest2020][b]Buntfest 2020[/b][/url] at the end of the month, a European tournament with a prize pool of 100€ and a bonus prize for the best corpse juggle during the tournament stream.

If you want to join any of the tournaments, they are all happening on discord:

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025459/1320f07777dc961a6e34b6551bbfd2bb28551cc5.png[/img]

We have reworked all character models and stages, tweaked visuals and drove over the code with a bulldozer a couple of times to vastly improve performance on Nintendo Switch in both docked and handheld mode. A 1v1 matchmaking mode is added for the competitively minded among a myriad of other fixes. Here’s the full list:[list][*] Improved performance
[*] Added 1v1 online mode
[*] Fixed certain un-unlockable outfits
[*] Fixed memory leaks
[*] Higher resolution for docked mode
[*] Correct system language on first start
[*] Character model fixes
[*] Fixed unnecessary server logouts

[h1]Tokyo Game Show trip[/h1]
Part of the team just returned from a trip to Japan. Showing Blaze at Tokyo Game Show and being there while the boxed version released in stores was a blast! Turns out that the Japanese fans are just as hyped up as the fans from everywhere else. The team got showered with gifts, hosted a tournament at the Dutch Embassy, did interviews and had an idol group play our game (peak Japanese right there). We even bought our own game too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025459/e4fe0156c3b288943554c0c0e9118ef335e4d95b.jpg[/img]

Physical releases are still pretty relevant in the land of the rising sun and Dion has never hidden the fact that he gets a lot of inspiration from Japanese creators. For these reasons it made sense to do a Japan-exclusive special edition for Switch and PS4. However, since the language can be switched ingame and they’re both region free, you can still buy the box from abroad, get the goodies and play it as you would normally. It contains the game, a sticker, an artbooklet and a little Candyman keychain. I’d say it’s a must for collectors.

notes.content:
Dropping shit like a pigeon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/a9af936d30aa1fd7d6621a1595553f7ad22286d5.png[/img]

[b]Grid[/b]

Grid gets two JUMPER CABLER outfits and an extra move in this update. For his new special move you have to get a full meter, crouch and then press jump to activate 'Electrostatic Charge'. It gives you a full charge hit the next time you hit the ball.


[b]Ranked[/b]

The Ranked mode is completely changed into a division system. With this, a new season starts and ranks will be reset. But before we do, let's go over the top ranking players of season 1. On the leaderboards Twitch-DizzyyHM sits on the #1 spot and they worked for it, no doubt about it. However, since we're honoring single competitors on this list and this is a shared account we considered it only fair to the others to reduce DizzyyHM's rank somewhat. 

Top Rankings Lethal League Blaze Season 1:
 
[list]
[*] #1 Sivil
[*] #2 Daioutzu
[*] #3 Monk/Honkey/Banana
[*] #4 Hang Boy
[*] #5 mylokolya
[*] #6 Prometheus
[*] #7 Zaxer2
[*] #8 88mpharu
[*] #9 Metrekec
[*] #10 Twitch-DizzyyHM
[*] #11 meller roll soul

[*] #15 CandyMaster145
[*] #16 Tixl

[*] #18 Battler

[/list]

Gratz to all these players! The new system won't feature a leaderboard in the same way, making way for the Divisions. Divisions go from the 8th Division all the way up to the 1st Division. Every Division has three Stars to more specifically show where you are placed. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/5daa31f4d44c67fb6d0caf9c45d70969849c88ec.gif[/img]

After each Ranked match you'll be able to see your progress to the next division in the result screen. Winning will make the bar go up, losing will make it go down. Even if you're at the bottom of the bar you're allowed to lose 2 times more before you will get demoted. Once you've played Ranked once, your current rank will be visible in the main menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/36bf9c3407be3259e18da827f8b6abd1bca9fa02.png[/img]

With Ranked season 1 coming to an end, 'Some Person' is sending it off with a tournament called "How far will your rank get you?".

It takes place on January 27, 2019 at 10:00 PM EET and will use season 1 ranks for seeding: [url=]https://challonge.com/Llbrank[/url]

Prove yourself or show everyone that ranks aren't everything and get a hardcore role on the official discord!

And if you need some original Lethal League action as well, Bitcoin keeps hosting the Underground Dojo Weekly, with the 23rd iteration happening January 26, 2019 at 2:00 PM CST: [url=]https://challonge.com/LLUweek23[/url]

Also a playlist of the second FellowsTV Open Circuit matches with commentary from Bipmap and Monk is online, check it out! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LHlz8bSIrsM&list=PLM3kRE-69XRtbOHTDF_ljzyLIBHybObzj

Some new advanced techs are introduced in this update:[list] 
[*] Sliding grabs
[*] Pivots, allowing you to more quickly turn around
[*] Early release charge hits, allowing full charge hits even if you release 4 frames earlier
[/list]
You can crouch and press the opposite direction within 4 frames (including simultaneously) to cancel the crouch and execute a pivot. They won't be necessary all the time, but they can come in handy in critical moments. Gameplay has seen a lot of tweaks in general, take a look down here to see all the changes in this Content Bombardment!


[b]List of changes:[/b]

[/list]

[*] K.O. velocity is decreased from 150 to 120

[*] Parry extension is changed from a 30% decrease in duration to 22%.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed grabdeny not working until the very end of hitpause if you parry before it
[*] Fixed Latch wall swings resetting diminishing returns without hitting the ball
[*] Fixed Raptor not being able to grab from wallslide
[*] Fixed instant turn bunts not working during movement animations

notes.title: New Year New News ROUND-UP
notes.content:
[h1]The OST[/h1]

We're back with the latest on Lethal League Blaze! Just a little back, on the edge of last year, we released the Lethal League Blaze Soundtrack here on Steam.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/04b9deebb969a98f56a1e314056a0d487aecc568.png[/img]

To quote the page:
"[i]The Lethal League Blaze Soundtrack is an off-the-wall collection of bombtracks from artists all over the world.

Adoring the backside of this digital album are the likes of Hideki Naganuma and Frank Klepacki, the Russian experimentalist Pixelord, Ordinary Days' Klaus Veen and Bignic with his hard-hitting signature electro style. Joined by zeroSCAR, Grillo, chip-hop scientist Doctor Lazer and D Fast, hailing from Helsinki. And last, but not least, B. Bravo, Lean Rock and The Sleepers RecordZ bringing in the much needed b-boy breaks.[/i]"

The OST also includes environment concept art boards with 11 pieces of high res character art thrown in just for the heck of it (even though we have 10 characters in the game...).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/aeffe66ba58e43d5086cd2aa08d2fceeada9feef.png[/img]

Really, give it a check. The profits are split so it's a good way to support all the artists in one big swoop. And have a listen to their other work while you're at it!


[h1]Ranked Changes + Public Beta[/h1]

So for the upcoming Content Bombardment, ranks are going to be proper Divisions. Eight of them, the highest one being 1st Division. Every division has three Stars to more specifically show where you are placed. After each Ranked match you'll be able to see your progress to the next division in the result screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/36bf9c3407be3259e18da827f8b6abd1bca9fa02.png[/img]

The improvements for Ranked play have been a long time coming. As such we feel it's good to give them a test run. Everyone is free to give it a try by joining the public beta.

[b]Here's how to join the beta:[/b]
Right-click the game in your library and select properties. Then go to the Betas tab and select the public Beta from the drop-down menu. Please remember to switch back to opt-out afterwards because you can't play online with the other players while you're still in the Beta!
 
Tell us about any issues in the [url=https://discord.gg/reptilehideout]Team Reptile Discord[/url] in the #public-beta channel!


[h1]Community News[/h1]

This Saturday (that's tomorrow!) the first tournament of the year is already happening. It's hosted by hyhy and it's open to any region.

For the start time and sign up link, check out - https://challonge.com/hyhyllb2

This new years tournament will feature prizes for top 4 including $20 pot bonus, Megabyte Punch keys and other misc games, in addition to glicko seeding based on previous tournament results - https://braacket.com/league/LethalLeagueBlaze/ranking

Remember, all entrants can get a 'hardcore' role in the [url=https://discord.gg/reptilehideout]Team Reptile Discord[/url] by showing you participated in an endorsed tournament!

[b]Scheduled Events[/b]
Seeing as these tournaments keep coming, we'll be trying out scheduled events starting with FellowsTV's Lethal League Blaze Euro tournament on the 13th. Even if you're not entering, you'll be able to catch the stream and see some high level Blaze play and commentary. Be sure to subscribe to the Lethal League Blaze Steam community if you don't want to miss that!

More info on that FellowsTV's tournament can be found at https://twitter.com/FellowsTV


[h1]Next Content Bombardment and new Ranked Season[/h1]

As the public beta becomes more stable, we can start to look at the date when all the freshness will drop along with the start of the 'clean slate' Ranked season very soon. Stay Tuned!

notes.title: The Soundtrack + Upcoming Content Bombardment
notes.content:
[h1]The Soundtrack[/h1]

Finally, we're launching the full Lethal League Blaze OST on Steam! The soundtrack is something special to us, not only because of the wild variety of artists. Each of them has been picked based on their energy and how much of their personal style seeps through the tracks. Beyond ambience, showcasing wildstyle is an integral part of the vision of Lethal League.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/05922effb043f6969022e00b6181251e04285ec2.png[/img]

The soundtrack will feature non-looping versions of the in-game tracks, some of which haven't been released anywhere ever. The DLC contains both FLAC and MP3. To match the music, it includes early concept art of the stages in the game and promotional art of all the characters. The gains from the OST will be split amongst the composers and Team Reptile, so if you want to support the cause, look no further.

The Lethal League OST will be available next Monday on the 17th of December!


[h1]Community News[/h1]

For the Europeans: Just the day before the OST release, on the 16th, you can enter FellowsTV's Lethal League Blaze Singles tournament. It's an online tourney limited to Europe with a variety of other games being hosted as well (never heard of them).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2RHSskUv14E

For all the rules and sign-up, visit smash.gg/FTVOC 

Looking to start up your own online or offline tournament? Maybe give the Americans some love this time? Hit us up on Discord (at the bottom) and we might be able to help you out!


[h1]Upcoming Content Bombardment[/h1]

Next year will see the release of Lethal League Blaze on Xbox, Playstation and Switch, but that doesn't mean things are standing still on the PC side. New characters and outfits are being worked on all the time and you can expect info on those free additions, and more, next week.

Here's an early tease on that, called JUMPER CABLER

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/e716d33e5feaf21fa3fd570081c8ef9437c597c8.png[/img]

If you're feeling you need to chatter about all this, head on over to the official [url=https://discord.gg/reptilehideout]Team Reptile Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Content Bombardment - Hydrodynamic
notes.content:
In this brand new Content Bombardment we're adding more ways to flex. New styles to pick from and a way to have friends watch you do your thing to be exact.

Style

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/7ab5a2c82089c7424014fe2ec0dd0a3fdb0ec6d1.png[/img]

Jet is the first of the newcomers to get her special outfits. You'll have to discover yourself where to get them in the game (no peeking at Steam guides!). Once you find them, you can unlock them for Sparks in the characters section of the Showcase menu. Lucky you, because the amount of Sparks you get per match are upped in this update. And of course, we're still cooking up the special outfits of the other newcomers!

Spectator

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/bb6f4d16b55f3623225d0787a84cfe272a30c533.png[/img]

I'm sure we're all big fans of constant surveillance so you'll be happy to hear that you can now play the Police Drone and be a spectator of matches! Just host your own match and select the camera icon on a player to turn him or her into a spectator. Spectators are able to view the match without interfering, perfect for learning by example and to more easily stream tournaments.

- Added 2 new outfits for Jet: Hydrodynamic and Astrodynamic
- Increased smoney making
- How to Play 2 is unlocked by default now
- Reduced the amount of matches to get Retro stages somewhat
- Custom menu music now also plays in Character Select 
- Added an announcer voiceline for Character Select
- Spectator mode in hosted games

notes.title: The 1.08 of Fate
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/e53e1f2c701950eb20d48463c823609c971a6f34.png[/img]

Oh boy... we got big ol' bag of ones and zeros for you guys that I'm sure you fine virtual fellas will appreciate. I'll tell ya, I'm looking out over this digital prairie of electronic anti-gravity sports and, to be honest, it brings a tear to my left eye, though blinded in the great Shine City uprising some years ago. Hot damn, enough of that! Let's get right into it.

Ranked mode is seeing some additions. I especially like the option to quickly 'Continue' into a new match with either your last opponent or somebody else. The matchmaking has also been tweaked to look for more similar rank players. Bigger changes to the Ranked mode are planned for the next season, when the whole leaderboard will be reset to give everyone a chance again. For that, we're looking at around December for now, so be aware!

If you want to get at edge on the rest, know that we often do a public beta for upcoming changes. Join the official Discord server at discord.gg/reptilehideout and read the pins in the #betablaze channel. But remember to switch back once you're done, because you can't play with players who are not in the beta.

One last itty bitty thing. I sneakily added a match counter in the bottom of the main menu. These are your total matches played online AND offline.


[b]Patch Notes 1.08[/b]

[b]Online[/b]
- Matchmaking filters for Ranked are now more geared towards similar rank opponents
- No freeze anymore if a player disconnected just before match started
- Things don't go wrong anymore if host changes game mode while other player still in result screen
- Fixed players not seeing each other if joining a lobby at exactly the same time (causing desync at match start)
- Added a 'Continue' option after a Ranked match (you'll enter the lobby to find a new match)

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Fixed Nitro's grab guard on second special hit
- Added an option to do turn-around bunts in the air by holding up in the same way as the neutral swing 
- Fixed CPU's refusing to hit the ball when they get certain powerups

[b]General[/b]
- Fixed left shoulder button not working in online lobbies
- Added the total matches played statistic to the main menu 


Then the 1.071 hotfix from last time didn't get notes, so here's a recap with the more interesting stuff:

- Fixed Straitjacket Alert not unlocking
- Latch now regains his double jump if he cancels his wall-swing with a special
- Added missing Baldi Konijn in the credits, a magnificent concept artist who designed the backgrounds for us. Check him out: https://www.artstation.com/baldi-konijn

notes.title: Update 1.07 Live
notes.content:
That's right we jumped straight to 1.07.

The most important fix is the one with Quickmatch where some players needed to wait a lot longer while there were people readily available. Also the missing Frank Klepacki track in Showcase (sorry Frank!) and tons of small stuff in the visuals and gameplay. Scroll down past all the brabble to see the changes in detail!

Even though Ranked mode was a bonus that we didn't exactly plan to have on launch, we're very happy how avidly the mode is played (the please-take-a-break-for-your-health kind of avidly). I'm sure everyone is aware that Ranked mode will evolve over time, but thanks again for your patience.

Another thing of note is that modding is blowing up, with a big load of texture mods leading the way. Head over to #modding in the official Discord (discord.gg/reptilehideout) to learn how to do it too. Here's a showcase of some gems already:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/035a9c461406d631854f4d05b1567aa0547055a5.png[/img]

Then there's a Blaze tournament coming or should I say 'Doom Is Coming'... This Saturday on the 3rd of November all bets are off for this Lethal League Blaze tourney handled by your local Hangboy at 3PM EDT sharp on the official Discord in #competitive (discord.gg/reptilehideout).  

There's Megabyte Punch Steam keys to be won! Take a look at the rest of the rules over here:
https://challonge.com/DoomComing
Note that Beta testers from pre-release are not allowed to join this tournament.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025459/aa735e484a0fb549130e07f8a5ba10573187f16c.png[/img]

[b]Patch notes 1.07[/b]

[b]General[/b]
- Fixed crash when username contains } {
- Fixed various texts and dialog
- Fixed some 2D effects (thanks Dr. Melkpak)
- Fixed a few causes of softlocks
- 'Couldn't join' message now includes reason why
- Player names do not disappear anymore when russian or japanese are the selected language
- Quickmatch matches quicker
- Fixed the back end of the Workbot Factory assembly line
- Added missing Jawbreaker to credits

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Changed Nitro's special return swing hitpause from a half-shorten to a full shorten
- Changed Grid's special reactivation margins and made the spike option only straight down
- Nitro special pre-charge shorten should be fixed
- Grid can no longer bunt out of special (will probably get something in return later)
- Latch regains doublejump on bunt from wall, but can't instantly bunt from wall anymore
- Added a late turn option to first few frames of grounded swings
- Later story events will use 5 stocks again (as intended)

[b]Unlocks[/b]
- Changed the unlocking of outfits in the story mode to finishing the event without losing stocks. This goes for all outfits that had a story event requirement and removes their arcade mode requirement.
- Added the missing Frank Klepacki - Decible to Beats unlocks in Showcase
- Fixed the Vicious Volley achievement
- Fixed double unlock that caused negative Sparks
